title: Aye alamdar e man
body:
Aye alamdar e man
ya Abbas a.s (10)
Aey Alamdar e man Aey Sipah dar e man(2)
Aey wafadar e man Aa
Main hogaya tanha
Ya Abbas a.s(3)
1. Waqt e madad hai ba wafaa
darya pe ab sota hai kya
Halmin ki deta hu sada
sun aey Sakina a.s ke chacha
aey mere bawafaa aey mere dilruba aey mere mehlaqaan Aa
<<MINI>>
Main Hogya Tanha Ya Abbas a.s (3)
<<DIVIDER>>
2.  Aa dekh meri zindagi
Dard o alam main ghir gayi
zakhmi huwa rah war bhi
barhne lagi hai tishnagi
Tunay rakha bharam Har ghadi har qadam Phir uthalay Alam Aa
<<MINI>>
main hogaya tanha ya Abbas a.s (3)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Laashain utha kar thak gaya
Pucho na kese ghar gaya
Abbas phir main gir gaya
Samjhi Behn main mar gaya
haye kiya reh gaya hogayi inteha jaane Mushkil Kasha Aa
<<MINI>>
main hogaya tanha Ya Abbas a.s (3)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Bhaya mujhay yeh hai khabar
Be dast tu hai khaak par Phir bhi magar koshish to kar
Aja tarayi chod kar Tere baazoo qalam khoon main dooba Alam Hai Sakina a.s ko gham Aa
<<MINI>>
mai hogya tanha Ya Abbas (3)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Khanjar talay hai sar mera
zaalim hai seenay par charha
thi Sarwar o Rehan yeh
Mola e be Qas a.s ki sada
Aa mere bhai Aa Kat raha hai gala Aakhri hai sada Aa
<<MINI>>
main hogaya tanha ya Abbas a.s (3)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aey Alamdar e man Aey Sipah dar e man Aey wafadar e man Aa Main hogaya tanha Ya Abbas a.s(10)
